proof_body:
by
  intro a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ c₁ c₂ p₁ p₂ α β γ hα hβ hγ h1 h2
  have e1 : β * ((b₁ - p₁) * (c₂ - p₂) - (b₂ - p₂) * (c₁ - p₁)) = α * ((c₁ - p₁) * (a₂ - p₂) - (c₂ - p₂) * (a₁ - p₁)) := by
    linear_combination (c₂ - p₂) * h1 - (c₁ - p₁) * h2
  have e2 : γ * ((b₁ - p₁) * (c₂ - p₂) - (b₂ - p₂) * (c₁ - p₁)) = α * ((a₁ - p₁) * (b₂ - p₂) - (a₂ - p₂) * (b₁ - p₁)) := by
    linear_combination (b₁ - p₁) * h2 - (b₂ - p₂) * h1
  have a1 := congrArg abs e1
  have a2 := congrArg abs e2
  rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hα, abs_of_pos hβ] at a1
  rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hα, abs_of_pos hγ] at a2
  constructor <;> linarith
target_source: ∀ (a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ c₁ c₂ p₁ p₂ α β γ : ℝ), 0 < α → 0 < β → 0 < γ → α * (a₁ - p₁) + β * (b₁ - p₁) + γ * (c₁ - p₁) = 0 → α * (a₂ - p₂) + β * (b₂ - p₂) + γ * (c₂ - p₂) = 0 → β * (1 / 2 * |(b₁ - p₁) * (c₂ - p₂) - (b₂ - p₂) * (c₁ - p₁)|) = α * (1 / 2 * |(c₁ - p₁) * (a₂ - p₂) - (c₂ - p₂) * (a₁ - p₁)|) ∧ γ * (1 / 2 * |(b₁ - p₁) * (c₂ - p₂) - (b₂ - p₂) * (c₁ - p₁)|) = α * (1 / 2 * |(a₁ - p₁) * (b₂ - p₂) - (a₂ - p₂) * (b₁ - p₁)|)
